name: Risk Judge
description: 舆情风险研判工具：对一段舆情内容套用标准化评级规则（3 标准 / 5 级 → 蓝/黄/橙/红/高危预警）并结合权威媒体白名单，调用当前配置的模型产出可复现的研判正文与处置建议。可选结合 milvus 插件做历史案例检索，提升跨事件评级一致性。

timeoutMs.description: Max time to wait for the model to produce a 研判 before failing the tool.

enablePrecedentRag.description: Whether to ask the model to search/store historical cases via the milvus plugin's milvus_search/milvus_upsert tools for cross-event consistency. Requires the milvus plugin to be configured and both plugins' tools to be allowed on the target agent's tools.profile.

precedentCollection.description: Base milvus collection name for historical cases. The actual collection is suffixed per agent (e.g. risk_judge_cases_<agentId>) so tenants never share precedent data.

precedentTopK.description: How many historical cases to request from milvus_search when enablePrecedentRag is on.
